# PathPricer

Institutional-grade European option pricing platform using Monte Carlo simulation with variance reduction techniques and Black-Scholes analytical benchmarks.

## What It Does

PathPricer prices European call/put options via Monte Carlo simulation with 5 variance reduction estimators (Standard, Antithetic Variates, Control Variates, Combined, Randomized QMC/Sobol). It benchmarks results against Black-Scholes closed-form solutions, computes analytical and finite-difference Greeks, and provides convergence diagnostics.

## Key Features

- 5 Monte Carlo estimators with variance reduction
- Black-Scholes analytical benchmark
- Analytical Greeks (Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta, Rho)
- Finite-difference Greeks with Common Random Numbers
- Convergence analysis (slope, R², log-log)
- Implied volatility solver (Newton-Raphson / Brent)
- P&L attribution via Taylor decomposition (Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta, Greeks)
- Risk grid heatmap (underlying × volatility mesh)
- Payoff diagram and terminal distribution charts
- CSV and PDF report export
- Live market data for US and Indian equities

## Pages

- `/` — Markets: live quotes and ticker strip
- `/workspace` — Workspace: option pricing, IV solver, P&L explain
- `/validation` — Validation: CI coverage, edge cases, Greeks tests
- `/docs` — Documentation: mathematical specification, method descriptions, convergence theory

## API

Backend is FastAPI at `https://pathpricer-backend.onrender.com`:

- `POST /api/v1/price/full` — Full simulation with all estimators and Greeks
- `POST /api/v1/price/preview` — Fast preview (≤10k paths)
- `POST /api/v1/price/implied-vol` — Implied volatility solver
- `POST /api/v1/price/pnl-explain` — P&L attribution decomposition
- `POST /api/v1/price/risk-grid` — Risk grid heatmap data
- `GET /api/v1/market/quote` — Live market quote
- `POST /report/pdf` — PDF report generation

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Recharts, KaTeX
- Backend: FastAPI, NumPy, SciPy, ReportLab
- Deployment: Vercel (frontend), Render (backend)
